system.description: The sasquatch are a very shy race of low intelligence who dwell deep within dark woods and in high mountains. The creature is a tall apelike creature with a crested head, large feet, and a thick mat of hair (dark brown in woods, white in mountains). It is omnivorous, occasionally slaying animal prey but usually eating plants and berries. Although not aggressive, it will defend itself and its cavern lair ferociously (morale 11), attacking with clublike fists. In combat, it can also throw boulders to a 50' range (damage 2d8 points). Also, if both hands hit one victim, the sasquatch hugs for an additional 4d6 points of damage. Common names for sasquatch include "Bigfoot" (the woodland variety) and "Yeti" or "Abominable Snowman" (the mountain folk). Snow apes (q.v.) are also often called by the latter two names.
